payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP over subsequence length L, processing array in order; for each a[i] iterate divisors j descending, update dp[j] += dp[j-1] if j divides a[i].
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single dp array indexed by length (1D state). It iterates over elements and updates length counts using divisors. No 2D or tree structures.
